tools.name: create_idea
tools.description: Create a new content idea in a Buffer organization. Ideas are drafts for future social media posts — use them to capture concepts, attach media, and tag with categories. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Returns the created idea record. Do not use this tool to publish or schedule posts.

organizationId.description: The ID of the organization to create the idea in. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Tell the user which organization (by name) you are creating the idea in.

title.description: Title or headline of the idea.

text.description: Main body text or description.

media.description: List of media items to attach to the idea.

url.description: Direct http(s) file URL that is publicly downloadable: not a local file path, not a share or preview page, not a temporary host that expires.

type.description: The type of media. Note: 'video' is not supported via the public API.

thumbnailUrl.description: URL to a smaller preview version of the media.

color.description: Hex color code for the tag (e.g., "#F523F1").

services.description: Target social media platforms for the idea.

date.description: Target date for the idea in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-03-15T10:00:00Z").

content.description: Content and metadata for the new idea.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description:
Create and schedule a social media post to a Buffer channel. Supports all platforms: Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business, Mastodon, TikTok, Threads, Bluesky, Substack, and Start Page. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Use list_channels if the channel ID is unknown. 

Minimum requirements by service:
- Twitter/Mastodon/Threads/Bluesky: text only
- Facebook: requires metadata.facebook.type
- Instagram: requires image or video asset + metadata.instagram.type
- TikTok: requires image or video asset
- Pinterest: requires image + metadata.pinterest.boardServiceId (get from get_channel)
- YouTube: requires video + metadata.youtube.title + metadata.youtube.categoryId
- Substack: text, an image or video asset, or metadata.substack.linkAttachment
- Google Business: requires metadata.google.type


For threaded posts, set BOTH outer text and metadata.{platform}.thread, include ALL thread items, match outer text to the first item's text, and use the top-level asset shape for thread assets. To give a Threads or Bluesky thread item a link preview card, set metadata.{platform}.linkAttachment on that item.

Returns the created post with saved content, assets, platform settings, tags, allowedActions, status, and scheduling details.

channelId.description: Must be an exact ID returned by list_channels for the selected organization; never guess. Ask the user if organization or channel selection is unclear.

schedulingType.description: notification: Buffer reminds the user to publish the post by hand. Required for Facebook Groups (type group) and Instagram personal profiles (type profile). Also allowed for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, only when the user asks for a reminder. Use automatic everywhere else.

mode.description: addToQueue (default), shareNow (publish immediately), shareNext (next scheduled slot), customScheduled (requires dueAt). Use addToQueue unless the user explicitly asks otherwise.

dueAt.description: ISO 8601 with timezone offset (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss±hh:mm); required for customScheduled. Build the offset from the get_account timezone and anchor relative times ("tomorrow") on its currentTime; must be in the future.

assets.description: Each item is exactly one of: { image }, { video }, or { document } (LinkedIn only). In each shape, url: Direct http(s) file URL that is publicly downloadable: not a local file path, not a share or preview page, not a temporary host that expires. Image metadata: altText is accessibility text; animatedThumbnail is the animated-image thumbnail URL; userTags is for Instagram with x/y normalized 0-1. Video metadata.thumbnailOffset is in milliseconds. A link preview card is not an asset. Use metadata.{platform}.linkAttachment for it, and do not send it with a non-empty assets array.

tools.name: create_post_template
tools.description: Create a reusable post template in a Buffer organization. Templates capture content starting points whose body may contain {{placeholders}}. Set visibility to private (only you) or internal (shared with the organization). Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Returns the created template. This does not schedule or publish a post.

organizationId.description: The ID of the organization the template belongs to. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Tell the user which organization (by name) you are creating the template in.

body.description: The main content body of the template. May contain {{placeholders}}.

description.description: A short user-facing description of the template.

visibility.description: Who can access the template: private (only you, the default) or internal (all members of the organization). The public scope is Buffer-curated only and can't be set.

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Permanently delete a post from Buffer. This action is irreversible. Use list_posts if the post ID is unknown.

postId.description: The ID of the post to delete. Use list_posts if the post ID is unknown.

tools.name: delete_post_template
tools.description: Permanently delete a post template from Buffer. This action is irreversible. You can delete templates you own, or internal templates in your organization if you are an org admin/owner. Use list_post_templates if the template ID is unknown.

postTemplateId.description: The ID of the template to delete. Use list_post_templates if the template ID is unknown.

tools.name: edit_post
tools.description:
Edit an existing post in Buffer. Reuse known post details. Use get_post when required information is missing or up-to-date data is requested or needed. Leave schedulingType out unless the user is switching between reminder and automatic publishing: omitting it keeps the post publishing the way it already does. Leave mode and dueAt out unless the user is rescheduling: omitting them keeps the post in its current queue slot or custom time. Sending a mode reschedules the post even when it matches the current one.

Every edit is re-validated as a whole post against the same rules as creation; it is not merged with the stored post. Carry the current assets and metadata forward and change only what the user asked to change. Dropping an asset or metadata field the post requires will reject the edit.

For threaded posts, set BOTH outer text and metadata.{platform}.thread, include ALL thread items, match outer text to the first item's text, and use the top-level asset shape for thread assets. To give a Threads or Bluesky thread item a link preview card, set metadata.{platform}.linkAttachment on that item.

Returns the updated post with saved content, assets, platform settings, tags, allowedActions, status, and scheduling details.

postId.description: Use list_posts if the post ID is unknown.

schedulingType.description: notification: Buffer reminds the user to publish the post by hand. Required for Facebook Groups (type group) and Instagram personal profiles (type profile). Also allowed for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, only when the user asks for a reminder. Use automatic everywhere else.

mode.description: addToQueue, shareNow (publish immediately), shareNext (next scheduled slot), customScheduled (requires dueAt). Omit to keep the current schedule.

dueAt.description: ISO 8601 with timezone offset (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss±hh:mm); only valid with customScheduled. Build the offset from the get_account timezone and anchor relative times ("tomorrow") on its currentTime; must be in the future.

assets.description: To carry existing media forward, map source to url and (images only) thumbnail to thumbnailUrl. Never set thumbnailUrl on video assets; use metadata.thumbnailOffset to pick a frame instead (Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest only). Omit to preserve stored media; an empty array clears all assets; a non-empty array replaces them. Each item is exactly one of: { image }, { video }, or { document } (LinkedIn only). In each shape, url: Direct http(s) file URL that is publicly downloadable: not a local file path, not a share or preview page, not a temporary host that expires. Image metadata: altText is accessibility text; animatedThumbnail is the animated-image thumbnail URL; userTags is for Instagram with x/y normalized 0-1. Video metadata.thumbnailOffset is in milliseconds. A link preview card is not an asset. Use metadata.{platform}.linkAttachment for it, and do not send it with a non-empty assets array.

metadata.description: Carry the existing metadata forward unless the user is changing it; dropping a required field (such as an Instagram post's type) will reject the edit.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns account details (id, email, name, timezone), currentTime (account local time with UTC offset), and organizations (id, name, plan limits, member count). Pass organizations[].id as organizationId in other tools. Reuse the selected organization ID in this conversation. Call when required information is missing or up-to-date data is requested or needed. If organization selection is unclear, list organizations by name and ask which to use.

tools.name: get_aggregated_post_metrics
tools.description: Returns aggregate post analytics (sums and averages) for a Buffer organization over a date range. Use this when the user wants totals across many posts — e.g. "total reach in the last 2 weeks", "engagement on posts tagged #launch". Free plans: startDateTime must be within the last 31 days. The response always includes a baseline trio of metrics (postCount, reactions, comments); additional metrics (reach, impressions, engagement rate, etc.) are included only when every channel in the filter set supports them. The `metricsUpdatedAt` field carries the freshness of the aggregate — metrics refresh daily, so values can lag the source network by up to ~24h. It is null when no posts matched the filter. For per-post analytics on a single post, use get_post; for many posts, use list_posts. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown; use list_channels if needed channel IDs are unknown.

organizationId.description: The ID of the organization to aggregate metrics for. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Tell the user which organization (by name) you are querying.

startDateTime.description: Start of the aggregation window as an ISO 8601 date-time string (e.g., "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"). Inclusive. The range from startDateTime to endDateTime is capped to 365 days.

endDateTime.description: End of the aggregation window as an ISO 8601 date-time string (e.g., "2026-01-31T23:59:59Z"). Inclusive. The range from startDateTime to endDateTime is capped to 365 days.

channelIds.description: Channel IDs to include in the aggregate. Omit (or pass null) to aggregate across every channel the actor can see insights for. Passing an empty array filters out all channels and returns an empty result. Use list_channels if needed channel IDs are unknown.

items.description: A channel ID to include in the aggregate.

tags.description: Filter to posts with specific tags. Omit to include all posts regardless of tags.

in.description: Tag IDs to include posts from (OR semantics — a post matches if any of its tags appear in this list).

isEmpty.description: If true, also include posts that have no tags assigned. Combinable with `in` for a union filter. Defaults to false.

tools.name: get_channel
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific social media channel. Returns posting schedule, posting goals, queue status, timezone, link shortening config, and service-specific metadata (e.g., Pinterest boards, Mastodon server URL, Instagram reminder settings). Use list_channels if the channel ID is unknown.

channelId.description: The ID of the channel to retrieve. Use list_channels if the channel ID is unknown.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific post by ID. Returns comprehensive post data including status, content, author, channel references, tags, notes, assets (images, videos, documents), and allowedActions. The metadata field contains service-specific data (e.g., Instagram geolocation, Twitter threads, YouTube privacy settings, Pinterest boards). Posts with status "error" include an error field with the failure message. Set `includeMetrics: true` to additionally return per-post analytics (reactions, comments, impressions, etc.) and a `metricsUpdatedAt` freshness timestamp. Only set true when the user asks about post performance. Use list_posts if the post ID is unknown.

postId.description: The ID of the post to retrieve. Use list_posts if the post ID is unknown.

includeMetrics.description: Set true to also return per-post analytics (reactions, comments, impressions, etc.) and `metricsUpdatedAt` (freshness timestamp; metrics refresh daily, can lag up to ~24h). Default false — adds latency and response size. Only set true when the user asks about post performance.

tools.name: get_post_template
tools.description: Retrieves a single post template by ID. Returns the template body (which may contain {{placeholders}}), title, description, emoji, visibility, organizationId, and timestamps. Returns null if no template exists with the given ID. Use list_post_templates if the template ID is unknown.

postTemplateId.description: The ID of the template to retrieve. Use list_post_templates if the template ID is unknown.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: Lists all social media channels connected to a Buffer organization. Returns summary info (id, name, displayName, service, type, avatar, connection status). Use get_channel for detailed information about a specific channel, including posting schedule. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown.

organizationId.description: The ID of the organization to list channels for. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Tell the user which organization (by name) you are querying.

tools.name: list_idea_groups
tools.description: Lists all idea groups (columns) in the ideas board for a Buffer organization. Idea groups are used to organize ideas into named columns. Returns each group's id, name, and lock status. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown.

organizationId.description: The ID of the organization to list idea groups for. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown.

tools.name: list_ideas
tools.description: Lists content ideas from a Buffer organization, optionally filtered by tags. Ideas are drafts that capture concepts for future social media posts. Returns idea details including id, content (title, text, media, tags, target services, date), group, and timestamps. Supports pagination using Relay-style cursors. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Use create_idea to capture a new idea.

organizationId.description: The ID of the organization to list ideas for. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Tell the user which organization (by name) you are querying.

tagIds.description: Filter ideas to those tagged with any of these tag IDs (union/OR).

items.description: A tag ID to filter ideas by.

includeUntagged.description: Set true to also include ideas that have no tags assigned. Can be combined with tagIds. Defaults to false.

first.description: Number of ideas to return per page (default: 20, max: 100)

tools.name: list_post_templates
tools.description: Lists post templates available to the caller for a Buffer organization. Post templates are reusable content starting points whose body may contain {{placeholders}}. Returns public (Buffer-curated) templates, internal templates shared within the organization, and private templates you own, with fields (id, title, body, description, emoji, visibility, organizationId, timestamps) plus a totalCount. Supports Relay-style cursor pagination. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Use get_post_template for a single template, or create_post_template to add one.

organizationId.description: The ID of the organization whose templates to list. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Tell the user which organization (by name) you are querying.

visibility.description: Narrow to a single visibility scope. Omit to receive the union of: public (Buffer-curated) templates, internal templates from this organization, and private templates you own.

first.description: Number of templates to return per page (default: 20, max: 100)

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Lists posts from a Buffer organization with filters for channels, status, tags, and dates. Returns post details including id, status, allowedActions, via, text, scheduled/sent times, channel info, tags, assets, and errors. Supports pagination using Relay-style cursors. Set `includeMetrics: true` to additionally return per-post analytics on each post — only do so when the user asks about post performance, as it materially increases response size. For totals/sums across many posts, prefer `get_aggregated_post_metrics`. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown, and list_channels if needed channel IDs are unknown.

organizationId.description: The ID of the organization to list posts for. Use get_account if the organization ID is unknown. Tell the user which organization (by name) you are querying.

channelIds.description: Filter posts by specific channel IDs. Use list_channels if needed channel IDs are unknown.

items.description: A channel ID to filter posts by.

status.description: Filter posts by status (draft, needs_approval, scheduled, sending, sent, error)

items.description: A tag ID to filter posts by.

dueAt.description: Filter posts by their scheduled posting date

start.description: Include results with dates on or after this ISO 8601 date-time (e.g., "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z")

end.description: Include results with dates on or before this ISO 8601 date-time (e.g., "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z")

createdAt.description: Filter posts by the date they were created

start.description: Include results with dates on or after this ISO 8601 date-time (e.g., "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z")

end.description: Include results with dates on or before this ISO 8601 date-time (e.g., "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z")

field.description: The field to sort by (dueAt or createdAt)

first.description: Number of posts to return per page (default: 20, max: 100)

includeMetrics.description: Set true to also return per-post analytics (reactions, comments, impressions, etc.) and `metricsUpdatedAt` on each post. Default false — adds latency and response size; with up to 100 posts per page, the cost adds up. Only set true when the user asks about post performance. For totals across many posts, prefer `get_aggregated_post_metrics`.

tools.name: update_post_template
tools.description: Update an existing post template in Buffer. Only the fields you provide are changed; omit a field to leave it unchanged. You can edit templates you own, or internal templates in your organization if you are an org admin/owner. Use get_post_template when required template details are missing or up-to-date data is requested or needed. Returns the updated template.

postTemplateId.description: The ID of the template to update. Use list_post_templates if the template ID is unknown.

body.description: The main content body of the template. May contain {{placeholders}}.

description.description: A short user-facing description of the template.

visibility.description: Who can access the template: private (only you) or internal (all members of the organization). The public scope is Buffer-curated only and can't be set.
